# Result files of the run of 2026-11-03

The stage results of one participant session on two `g7.48xlarge` (16 GPUs, allocation 637) with companion commit `e7598475`, copied for the chart tests in `tests/test_charts.py`. `baseline` and `efa` are the first runs of those stages, which the session's Module 2, 4 and 7 outputs show; a repeat later moved them to `attempts/`. Each `summary.json` leaves out the per-rank host names and the GPU UUIDs, which every summary of the run shares, and the host names in the other files are the Slurm node names `gpu-g7-1` and `gpu-g7-2`. The profile traces are not included; the chart tests take the three profile tables from the printed output of `tools/profile-table.py` in the same session.
